events.title: Local Sponsor Steps Up
events.text: A regional engineering firm liked what they saw at your open day and wires over a sponsorship bonus.
events.notes: Pure budget effect. [a, b] = random amount in range. Public post uses the actual amount.
events.post: 🤝 {team} announces a €{change.budget} partnership with a regional engineering firm!

events.title: CFD Breakthrough
events.text: An overnight CFD run finds a cleaner diffuser shape. The aero team is already printing parts.
events.notes: Pure stat effect gated on department size. Can't happen while aero_lead_sick is active.
events.post: 👀 {team} teases a new diffuser design on Instagram. "More downforce coming soon."

events.title: Sensor Batch Failure
events.text: Half of the new wheel-speed sensors failed bench testing, two weeks before competition.
events.notes: Decision event. Immediate hit, then a choice. 'run_without' guarantees sensor_dropout two rounds later.

decision.prompt: Pay for a rush replacement, or race without the redundant sensor set?

options.label: Rush replacement
options.result: The replacement batch passed bench testing.

options.label: Run without
options.description: Save the money and accept the risk.
options.result: The car now runs on a single sensor set. Fingers crossed.

events.title: Sensor Dropout at Testing
events.text: The single wheel-speed sensor cut out mid-run, traction control shut down and the car limped back to the pits.
events.notes: Weight 0: never random, only fired as a follow-up from sensor_batch_failure.
events.post: 😬 Spotted at the test track: {team}'s car being pushed back to the pits.

events.title: Crunch Burnout
events.text: Weeks of all-nighters take their toll. A handful of people from your biggest department hand in their resignations.
events.notes: Personnel effect with a dynamic department target and an OR condition. Counts burnouts in a flag.
events.post: 💼 LinkedIn: a {team} member is "excited to announce a new chapter" after an intense season.

events.title: Recruitment Day Ghost Town
events.text: Word got around campus that your team is a meat grinder. Nobody signs up at the recruitment stand.
events.notes: Probabilistic chain: only eligible after two or more crunch_burnout events (flag counter).

events.title: A Generous Stranger
events.text: A startup founder in a very expensive jacket offers your team money. No paperwork, just a handshake.
events.notes: hideEffects: teams only see labels/descriptions. Accepting posts publicly and guarantees investor_scandal later. Custom timeout outcome.

options.label: Shake hands
options.result: €50,000 lands in the team account the same afternoon.
options.post: 🥂 {team} celebrates "a very generous new private backer".

options.label: Politely decline
options.result: The founder shrugs and walks over to the next team's pit.

onTimeout.result: While you were deliberating, the founder lost interest.

events.title: Investor Under Investigation
events.text: Your generous stranger is all over the news for fraud. The university freezes the money and your title sponsor walks.
events.notes: Weight 0: only fired as a follow-up from mystery_investor.
events.post: 📰 BREAKING: {team}'s mystery backer named in fraud investigation.

events.title: Aero Lead Down with Flu
events.text: Your aero lead is out for a fortnight, and nobody else knows how to book wind tunnel time.
events.notes: Ongoing modifier only, no immediate effect.

events.title: HV Safety Audit
events.text: Scrutineers announce a surprise high-voltage audit. Teams with shaky reliability must send every member to a certified HV course.
events.notes: Global: rolled once, hits every team matching the conditions. Cost scales with headcount.

events.title: Exchange Rate Swing
events.text: The euro jumps overnight. Teams paying suppliers from outside the eurozone lose purchasing power.
